mapper.sql: select s.*, coalesce(p.period_count, 0) as period_count, coalesce(p.punch_count, 0) as punch_count, p.period_summary from hr_shift s left join ( select shift_id, count(1) as period_count, sum((case when ifnull(need_in_punch, '1') = '1' then 1 else 0 end) + (case when ifnull(need_out_punch, '1') = '1' then 1 else 0 end)) as punch_count, group_concat( concat( ifnull(segment_name, concat('SEG', period_no)), ': ', date_format(start_time, '%H:%i'), '-', date_format(end_time, '%H:%i'), case when ifnull(cross_day, '0') = '1' then ' (+1)' else '' end ) order by period_no separator '; ' ) as period_summary from hr_shift_period group by shift_id ) p on p.shift_id = s.shift_id
mapper.select: where s.del_flag = '0' and (s.is_rest_shift = '1' or s.shift_code = 'SHIFT_REST') order by s.is_rest_shift desc, s.shift_id asc limit 1
